{{Top|leg}}
A '''data analyzer''' was part of [[Novaless Soni-Optics/Legends|Novaless Soni-Optics]]' [[Target Imager]]. It analyzed the data returned from the [[ultrasonic beam emitter]]s to create a three-dimensional sound pattern that appeared in the scope.
